hooks.name: Enforce Coding Standards
hooks.description: Injects coding standards verification prompt before any file write operation

action.prompt:
Before writing this file, verify the change follows these coding standards:
1. Use clean architecture patterns (domain/application/infrastructure separation)
2. All domain logic must be framework-agnostic (no NestJS decorators in domain layer)
3. Use dependency injection via ports/interfaces defined in domain/ports
4. Follow NestJS conventions for infrastructure layer (decorators, modules, providers)
5. Use TypeScript strict typing - no `any` types without justification
6. Async functions must have proper error handling
7. Keep functions focused and under 30 lines where practical
8. Use descriptive variable/function names (no single-letter names outside loops)
If the change violates any of these, suggest corrections before proceeding.
